summary: Arsenal beat Sevilla 2-1 away in the Champions League, with Gabriel Jesus providing an assist for Gabriel Martinelli's goal at the end of the first half and scoring a superb second just after the break. Sevilla pulled one back through Nemanja Gudelj and pressed late, but Lucas Ocampos sliced a chance wide on the last kick. Mikel Arteta praised his side's ability to play different games within one match, and Arsenal went top of Group B.
one_line: Gabriel Jesus assisted and scored as Arsenal edged Sevilla 2-1 in the Champions League, finishing top of Group B after a nervy ending.
key_facts: Arsenal beat Sevilla 2-1 at the Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán Stadium in a Champions League Group B match.
Lucas Ocampos had the last kick of the game at 97 minutes and sliced it past David Raya's left hand into the stand.
Gabriel Jesus turned past two players and slid a pass through for Gabriel Martinelli, who ran alone from the halfway line and rolled the ball into an empty net just before half-time.
Sevilla goalkeeper Ørjan Nyland had denied Martinelli after 10 minutes when Jorginho released him, but could not stop him the second time.
Soon after the break, Jesus cut inside Jesús Navas and curled a shot into the far corner for 2-0.
Nemanja Gudelj headed in a corner nine minutes into the second half to make it 2-1 for Sevilla.
Substitute Mariano Díaz hit the bar with a shot after controlling the ball on his chest, and Ocampos went close with an overhead kick.
Mikel Arteta said his side had to play many games in one: controlling, holding on and striking when the chance came; he called it "a brutal experience".
Asked which Jesus contribution was better, Arteta replied "both" and said "this is our level now and we need players like that."
About 3,000 Arsenal fans watched from high in a corner of the stadium.
Sevilla fans unfurled a banner reading "Europe knows what we are capable of".
Dodi Lukebakio missed Sevilla's best early chance after a loose Raya pass, and Youssef En-Nesyri's shot faded past the far post.
Arsenal are top of Group B, while Sevilla face the prospect of another Europa League adventure.
